Commentary.Commentary: So, Australia need 163 runs to win and they have a strong batting line-up, consisting of Aaron Finch, David Warner and Steven Smith. They should back themselves to chase this down. England would need some quick wickets and they would hope that they manage to defend it. Join us for the chase in a while.

England, on the other hand, will be slightly disappointed as barring Buttler and Malan, no one was able to leave a mark and they could score only 162. They would have expected a lot more, considering the start that they got. Malan continued his great form in T20s while Buttler showed why he is such a dangerous player in the shortest format of the game. Apart from that, no one else contributed.

Good end to England's innings but it is Australia who will be the happier side at the break. The Aussies did not start off well at all as they looked rusty in the field and gave away easy runs to England. Once the Powerplay ended, they hit their strides and put a hold on the runs. They kept on picking wickets and have restricted England to 162. Kane Richardson was the pick of the bowlers as he picked up a couple of wickets, while Agar and Maxwell finished with two. Adam Zampa was a little disappointing as Malan got hold of him and thrashed him.

FOUR! A good end to the batting by Jordan! On a short length around off, Jordan pulls this again and it races away between the fielders at deep cover region for four runs. AUSTRALIA WILL NEED 163 RUNS TO WIN!
A full toss around middle, Jordan plays it past Cummins down the ground and will add two more runs to the total.
Short ball outside off, Jordan smacks this through to the deep cover region and the batters come back for the single.
BYE! On a good length outside off, Rashid looks to paddle but he misses as Carey collects, the players run for the single as Carey throws the ball to the stump but Jordan is in by a mile.
Great death bowling by Patty here! On a full length way outside off, Rashid looks to play at this but misses.
A full toss outside off, Jordan works this to the fielder at third man for one run.
Pat Cummins will bowl the final over. 2-0-15-1 are his figures so far.
Slower ball on middle, Rashid looks to paddle but misses.
Very full delivery on middle, Chris digs it out to point for a single.
Slower ball outside off, Jordan plays it towards deep cover and takes a couple.
On a length on off, Rashid plays it to the off side for a single.
Good length ball outside off, Jordan guides it to third man for a single.
Adil Rashid is in now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Brilliant hands from Smith has sent Malan packing! End of an excellent innings from Malan! He played all around the wicket! He goes back to the pavilion with a huge round of applause from his teammates. Short ball outside off, Malan looks to hammer it towards deep extra cover. Smith runs across and takes a magnificent catch.
Floated around off, Malan plays this on the up towards the long off region for a single to retain the strike. Great over for the hosts, 22 runs off it!

SIX! AND AGAIN! What batting by Malan pushing England past the 150-run mark here. Floated outside off, Malan lifts this one with power through the cover region and it crosses the fence for a biggie again. The gamble of Zampa not paying off here!
SIX! What a shot by Malan here! Floated around middle, Malan sweeps this one fine over the fence at deep square leg for a maximum.

5 WIDES! Welcome runs for the hosts at this stage! Flatter around leg, Malan looks to sweep this but doesn't connect but Carey doesn't pouch this as well and the ball runs away to the boundary near deep fine leg.
Floated on off, Malan plays this on the up through the cover region and the batters will get two runs.
Googly on middle, Jordan nudges this on his back foot to the leg side for a single.
Flatter outside off, Malan cuts this to the fielder at deep point for a single.
Adam Zampa will bowl now.

FIFTY! 7th T20I fifty for Dawid Malan. He is a brilliant T20 player and he is doing it again. He has kept the England innings together. He needs to finish well for the side though. Short ball on middle, Malan pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Chris Jordan comes out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Everything is going Australia's way! Tom Curran has to go! Richardson is a smart bowler and he shows it here again! Slower short ball outside off, Curran looks to heave it to the off side but does not get the timing on it. It goes straight to Agar at deep cover. He suggests that he did not see it but managed to take it.
Well bowled from Richardson! Slower ball on middle, Curran looks to paddle scoop it but misses as there was no pace on it.
Short ball on middle, Malan pulls it to deep square leg for a single. Malan moves to 49.
Excellent fielding! Saved a certain boundary! Good length ball outside off, Curran punches it towards extra cover. Warner dives and makes a good stop. A single taken.
Nearly chopped on! Short ball outside off, Curran looks to cut but it takes the bottom edge and goes to the keeper.
Kane Richardson comes into bowl. 1-0-5-0 are his figures so far.
Flatter around off, punched by Curran towards long on for a single.
Loopy outside off, Malan cuts this through point for a single.

Floated around off, Curran works this towards the deep cover region for a single. The bails are off as the keeper appeals that this is a hit-wicket. The umpire calls the third umpire into play but replays show that Carey was the one who whipped the bails out and not Curran, this is clearly not-out.
Has Tom Curran been dismissed Hit Wicket? No, he has not been as it was Carey who had whipped the bails off.
Floated around off, Curran comes down the pitch and plays this towards the fielder at mid-wicket.
Floated around middle, Malan tucks this to the leg side for one run.
Flatter around middle, Curran pushes this to long on for a single.
Looped up ball outside off, Tom plays it to deep cover and will keep the strike for the next over with a single. Agar finishes with 4-0-32-2.
Tossed up outside off, Malan drives it to long off for a single.
Floated on middle, Curran flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
On middle, Malan works it to square leg for a single.
FOUR! Excellent placement from Dawid Malan! He has to keep going here! Short ball outside off, Malan cuts it through the cover-point region for a boundary.
Flatter outside off, played to short third man.
Ashton Agar comes in to bowl. 3-0-24-2 are his figures so far.
Floated around off, Malan pushes this towards mid on for one run.
Tom Curran is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! The England batting falling like a pack of cards here! It seems like the visitors have been playing cricket for the past two months and not England based on these shots! Loopy around off, Ali looks to reverse sweep this but it comes off his outside edge and goes up in the air, Zampa runs in from short third man and takes an easy catch. England are in trouble here and Australia will look to capitalize here!
Flatter around middle and leg, Malan tucks this to the leg side for another single.
Flatter around middle, Ali punches this on his back foot through to the mid-wicket area for one run.
Loopy around middle, Ali plays this back to Maxwell.
Loopy outside off, Ali pushes this one to the point fielder.
FOUR! Good way to finish the over! Short and on middle, Malan rocks on his back foot and pulls it to the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Wrong'un on off, Ali lunges forward and defends it to point for a single.
Flatter one outside off, Malan punches it to deep cover for a single.
BYES! Beautifully bowled from Zampa! Tossed up outside off, Ali looks to drive but misses. Carey fails to collect it cleanly and the ball goes towards the leg side. A bye taken.
Full on middle, Malan pushes it to long on for a single.
SIX! Welcome back, Mr. Zampa! He floats this on middle, Malan goes on his knees and slog sweeps it over the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Loopy on off, punched through to long off for one run.
Moeen Ali makes his way out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one falls! This time it the skipper Eoin Morgan who will walk back to the pavilion. Not the greatest timing on this one by the captain! Loopy around middle, Morgan dances down the track and looks to play this on the up towards the leg side but it goes on the up, down the ground and Steve Smith runs in from long on and takes a wonderful catch! The fielding has been very refreshing by the visitors!
Flatter around middle and leg, Malan cuts this one through point for a single.
Tossed up around middle, Malan works this towards the deep mid-wicket region and the batters do well to return for the second.
Loopy around off, Malan pushes this towards mid off.
Loopy outside off, Malan plays this on the up towards the cover region and Cummins does well to cut this off. Two runs taken.
Glenn Maxwell comes into bowl.
Fullish ball on middle, Malan flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full delivery on off, driven to cover.

Morgan gets away with it! This is the kind of bowling you want to see from Starc! Almost fetched him a wicket! Short ball on middle, Morgan looks to pull but it takes the top edge. Luckily, for Morgan, it lands safely and the batters take a single.
FOUR! First-ball boundary for Morgan! Poor bowling from Starc! Cannot bowl full to this guy! Full delivery outside off, Morgan drives it through the cover region for a boundary.
Full on middle, Malan flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! That is some shot from Dawid Malan! Good length ball outside off, Malan drives it over the cover fielder and picks up a boundary. Good start to the over.
Floated around middle, Malan works this through to deep mid-wicket for a single to end the over.
Eoin Morgan, the skipper, comes out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust! The Lions need to beware as they do not want a downfall of wickets here! Loopy ball on off, Banton comes down the track a touch and plays this on the up towards the mid off region but he does not time this well as Finch comes under this and takes a brilliant catch! Banton will have to take the long walk back to the hut!
Floated around middle, Malan sweeps this on the up towards the leg side but it drops on the grass safely as the batters exchange ends.
Loopy on off, Banton cuts this one towards the short third man fielder for one more run.
Loopy outside off, Malan pushes this towards the deep cover region for one run.
Flatter around off, Banton works this towards point for a single.
Tosses this on off, Banton drives it to long off for a single.
Flighted on middle, Banton sweeps it to short fine leg.
Banton comes down the track and then converts it to a low full toss and pushes it to cover.
On middle, defended it to mid-wicket.
BEATEN! Nice comeback from Zampa! Quicker delivery outside off, Banton looks to cut but fails to get any bat on it.
FOUR! Banton has started to move well already! Flighted on off, Banton goes on his knees and reverse sweeps it over the short third man region for a boundary.
Loopy around off, Banton works this through to long off for a single to end the over. Good over for the Aussies as they scalp a wicket!
Tom Banton is the next man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! And the very dangerous Buttler has to depart here! Agar gets the score level to 1-1 after Jos smacked him in his first over! Loopy around off and middle, Jos smacks this on the up towards the deep mid-wicket region and the power generated is not enough to cross the fence as Cummins there makes no mistake. Buttler departs after a dangerous innings!
Loopy outside off, Buttler plays this towards the cover fielder.
Flatter and quicker on middle, Malan comes down the track a touch and works this through to long on for one run.
Tossed up around off, Jos plays this through to deep cover for a single.
Floated outside off, Jos pushes this towards the cover region.
Ashton Agar is back on. He went for 16 runs in his first over.
Outside off, pushed to cover.
FOUR! Beautiful shot from Malan! This should get him going! Flighted outside off, Malan creams the drive through the extra cover region for a boundary.
Short ball on middle, Buttler dances down and flicks it to deep mid-wicket. Buttler wants the second but Malan sends him back.
Flatter one outside off, Malan punches it to deep cover for a single.
Tossed up on middle, Malan tucks it to mid-wicket.
Floated on the pads, Buttler flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Adam Zampa is on now.
Good length around the off pole, Jos pushes this to the off side and the batters take a quick single. England are at 55/1 at the end of the first Powerplay.
Good length around middle and off, Buttler defends this one out.

EDGED BUT NO SLIP THERE! On a good length outside off, Malan looks to lift it through the cover region but it nips his outside edge and zips through the second slip region to the third man for a single.
On a good length around middle and leg, Buttler works this towards the square leg area for one run.
FOUR! Power hitting on display here by Buttler! On a good length outside off, Buttler smacks this through the cover region for four more runs.
Good length outside off, Buttler plays this towards the fielder at point.
Full delivery on off, pushed to mid off. Good comeback from Richardson after being hit for a boundary earlier in the over.
On a length on off, Malan pushes it to cover.
Good length ball on middle, Malan works it to mid-wicket.
Full delivery on middle, Malan shuffles across and flicks but finds the short fine leg fielder.
FOUR! Not the right line and length to bowl to the new batsman! Malan gets off the mark with a boundary! Short ball on the pads, Malan just helps it on its way to the deep square leg fence.
Good length ball on middle, Buttler flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Dawid Malan makes his way out to the middle. Kane Richardson also comes onto bowl.

OUT! CAUGHT! What captaincy by Finch here! Gets the third man up next to the keeper as a deep slip and the very next ball, a catch comes his way and he makes no mistake. Bairstow doesn't perform here and goes out on a cheap score. Back of a good length outside off, the bounce is massive as Bairstow looks to defend this but it kisses his outside edge and Starc there at first slip pouches this one with ease. More of these for the Australians!
Good length outside off, it comes off Jonny's outside edge and goes towards the deep slip region and the batters will collect a couple here.
Good bowling by Pat! On a full length around leg, Buttler pushes this towards point and Agar will throw this at the stumps but he misses.
Good length outside off, Jos pushes this towards the fielder at point.
FOUR! Buttler is in some mood here! What a classy shot by Jos! On a good length outside off, Buttler lifts this one over the cover region and will collect four more runs.
Back of a length outside off, Bairstow works this towards short fine leg for a single.
Pat Cummins is brought into the attack.

FOUR! Another big over for England! This was not a bad delivery but that is the class of Jos Buttler! Very full delivery outside off, Buttler drives it through point and picks up another boundary. England have raced to 35 runs in 3 overs.
BEATEN! Full delivery outside off, Buttler goes for a huge swing but misses it completely.

FOUR! What a shot that is from Jos Buttler! This was pure timing! Nothing wrong with the delivery but it was just a classy shot! Good length ball outside off, Buttler drives it through covers and it races to the fence.
Good length ball on off, Buttler taps it to third man and picks up a couple.
Hammered but just a single! Short ball on middle, Bairstow pulls it to mid-wicket. Stoinis makes a half-stop and the ball rolls to mid on. A single taken.
Full delivery on the pads, Bairstow looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but nothing from the umpire.

SIX! Another biggie to end the over for Buttler! Agar is proving to be very expensive here! Loopy around off, Buttler hits this again down the ground straight past the fence at long on for six more runs. Great over for the hosts, 16 runs off it!
Flighted around off, Jos pushes this one towards point again.
Loopy around off, Buttler works this one towards point.

FOUR! 10 runs off the last two balls here! Buttler turning it on here for the Lions! Tossed up around off, Buttler hits this on his back foot through the mid-wicket region and it bounces just before the rope for four runs.
SIX! Buttler with a beauty of a shot! Agar under pressure here! Floated around off, Buttler dances down the track a touch and smacks this over the fence at long off for a biggie.
Full toss around off to start off, Buttler pushes this towards the cover region.
Ashton Agar will bowl from the other end.

FOUR! Good end to the over and it is a good start for England! Starc dishes a good length ball outside off, Bairstow leans forward and drives it through extra cover. He did not time it well but still had enough to reach the fence.
BEATEN! This is lovely from Starc! He needs to be more on this channel! Good length ball outside off, Bairstow looks to defend but misses as the ball rolls to the keeper.
Very full delivery outside off, Buttler drives it to deep point for a single.
Chipped in the air but safe! Good length ball angling in, Buttler flicks it past the mid-wicket fielder and picks up a couple before the fielder cuts it off.
Starc looks rusty at the moment! Buttler will feel that he missed out there! A full toss on off, Buttler only manages to push it to mid off.
Very full delivery outside the off stump line, Buttler looks to dig it out but misses. Much better from Starc.
WIDE TO START! Starc starts with a wayward delivery! Good length ball way outside off, Buttler leaves it alone. Wide given.
We are all set to begin! The Australian players walk out to the middle, followed by Jonny Bairstow and Jos Buttler. Mitchell Starc will start with the ball for the visitors with Buttler on strike.

Eoin Morgan, the England skipper, says that they are playing 4 quicks and Moeen Ali as an all-rounder. States that Malan will bat at 3 with Banton at 4. Adds that Buttler has been a find in the top order. Says that they need to bowl well in the Powerplay and is hopeful that it starts today. Goes onto say that the bowlers were rusty in the previous series but there were a lot of positives to take. Adds that everybody has got to get back to playing cricket at some stage.
Aaron Finch, the Australian skipper, says that they will bowl first. Adds that they have had a good practice in the nets and is rearing to go.
The England players will be wearing black armbands today in respect of David Capel who passed away earlier in the week. He played 15 Tests and 23 ODIs for England in the 1980s.
Australia (Playing XI) - Aaron Finch (C), David Warner, Steven Smith, Glenn Maxwell, Alex Carey (WK), Marcus Stoinis, Ashton Agar, Pat Cummins, Mitchell Starc, Kane Richardson, Adam Zampa.
England (Playing XI) - Jonny Bairstow, Jos Buttler (WK), Dawid Malan, Tom Banton, Eoin Morgan (C), Moeen Ali, Chris Jordan, Tom Curran, Jofra Archer, Mark Wood, Adil Rashid.
Toss - Up goes the coin and it lands in favour of Australia. They have elected to bowl.
Weather report - The weather is cloudy but it is pretty dry at the moment. Let's hope that it stays that way and we get a full game in.

Time for the first T20I! Australia arrive in England to play 3 T20Is followed by the same number of ODIs. First up will be the T20Is starting in Southampton. England will be slightly favourites as they have had match-practice before this game while the Aussies might be rusty having not played international cricket since March, 2020. The hosts though would do well to not underestimate the visitors as they have a strong squad at their disposal. England have got their big guns back for the series and it promises to be a mouth-watering contest. Toss and team updates in a while.
